title: Descent data for closed immersions over an fpqc covering are effective
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For an fpqc covering and a descent datum whose morphisms V_i -> X_i are closed immersions, the lemma asserts effectivity (statement lines 9423-9432). The proof identifies the mechanism: a closed immersion is affine, so the affine effectivity lemma applies directly (proof lines 9434-9437). The level is H2: a one-step reduction, but the reduction is the content -- recognising affineness as the hypothesis that unlocks the earlier result.
